ex-back-assisted-pull-up-machine.name: Assisted Pull-Up
steps: Find the assisted pull-up machine with steps and a moving knee pad. Select an assistance weight. A heavier setting gives you more help.
Step up, grip the overhead handles with palms facing away, and place your knees on the pad. Lower until your arms are straight.
Pull yourself up until your chin is level with the handles or just above them. Lower slowly.
Keep hold of the handles as you move your feet back onto the steps.

ex-back-back-extension.name: Machine Back Extension
steps: Find the seated machine with a footrest and a moving pad behind your back. Set the pad so you start leaning slightly forward.
Sit with your feet braced and back against the pad. Press back smoothly until your torso is upright.
Return slowly to the forward lean, keeping your hips on the seat.

ex-back-barbell-pullover.name: Barbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor. Hold a light barbell above your chest with a shoulder-width grip and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head. Stop before your lower back arches farther.
Bring the bar back above your chest along the same arc, keeping the bend in your elbows fixed.

ex-back-behind-neck-pulldown.name: Behind-the-Neck Lat Pulldown
steps: Find the lat pulldown station with a thigh pad and a long bar attached overhead. Use a light weight and a wide overhand grip. Sit with your thighs under the pad.
Drive your elbows down and out. Bring the bar behind your head only as far as you can keep your neck neutral and shoulders comfortable.
Let your arms straighten slowly. If you have to duck your head or feel shoulder discomfort, pull the bar to your chest instead.

ex-back-cable-one-arm-pulldown.name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Attach a single handle to a high cable pulley. Face the machine and step back.
Start with your hand in front of you and above shoulder height, elbow slightly bent. Sweep the handle down to your thigh without bending your elbow farther or twisting.
Let the handle rise slowly, then switch arms after the set.

ex-back-cable-straight-arm-pulldown.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
steps: Attach a short straight bar to a high pulley. Face the machine, grip the bar with both hands, and step back.
Soften your knees and lean forward slightly with a flat back. Sweep the bar from head height down to your thighs with elbows slightly bent.
Let your arms rise slowly while keeping the same torso angle.

ex-back-chin-up.name: Chin-Up
steps: Grip a pull-up bar about shoulder-width apart with palms facing you. Hang with your arms straight.
Drive your elbows down and pull until your chin clears the bar. Keep looking ahead.
Lower to straight arms without swinging your legs.

ex-back-dumbbell-row.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand. Soften your knees and push your hips back until the weights hang below your shoulders. Keep your back flat.
Row both weights toward your waist, sending your elbows back close to your sides. Keep your torso still.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are straight.

ex-back-high-row-machine.name: Machine High Row
steps: Find a seated row machine with two handles that start high in front of you. Set the seat so you can reach them comfortably.
Plant your feet and use the chest pad if there is one. Pull both handles down and back toward your ribs.
Let the handles rise slowly without leaning forward to follow them.

ex-back-hyperextension.name: 45-Degree Back Extension
steps: Use the angled bench with a hip pad and ankle rollers. Plant your feet and tuck your heels under the rollers.
Set the top of the pad just below your hip crease and cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge at the hips to lower your torso while keeping your back flat.
Rise until your torso and legs form a straight line. Stop there.

ex-back-incline-barbell-row.name: Incline Chest-Supported Barbell Row
steps: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline and lie face down with your feet planted. Place the bar on low supports you can reach easily.
Use an overhand grip just wider than your shoulders. Pull the bar to your lower ribs while keeping your chest on the bench.
Lower the bar slowly to straight arms.

ex-back-incline-dumbbell-row.name: Incline Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline and lie face down with your feet planted. Let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back close to your sides.
Straighten your arms slowly while keeping your chest on the bench.

ex-back-inverted-row.name: Inverted Row
steps: Use a fixed low bar or lock the bar of a Smith machine at about waist height. Grip it just wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Walk your feet out and rest on your heels. Keep your body straight and pull your chest toward the bar.
Straighten your arms slowly. Raise the bar or bend your knees to make it easier.

ex-back-lat-pull-down.name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Use a lat pulldown station with a thigh pad and a long bar overhead. Grip just wider than shoulder width, palms facing away, and sit with your thighs under the pad.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest by driving your elbows down.
Let your arms straighten overhead, keeping the same slight lean.

ex-back-lateral-wide-pull-down.name: Wide-Grip Machine Lat Pulldown
steps: Find a lever-style pulldown machine with two widely spaced handles above the seat.
Take an overhand grip and sit with your thighs under the pad if the machine has one.
Pull the handles to shoulder level by driving your elbows down. Let the handles rise without swinging your torso.

ex-back-low-row-machine.name: Machine Low Row
steps: Find the seated row machine with a chest pad and two low handles in front. Sit down, brace your feet, and take the handles.
Pull the handles back and up toward your waist. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your chest against the pad.
Slowly straighten your arms as the handles move forward.

ex-back-lying-barbell-row.name: Barbell Seal Row
steps: Lie face down on a raised flat bench with enough clearance for a barbell underneath. Let your arms hang and take the bar from low supports.
Row the bar toward the underside of the bench at lower-rib level. Drive your elbows back and keep your chest on the bench.
Lower the bar slowly to straight arms.

ex-back-mag-grip-lat-pulldown.name: MAG-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach the MAG handle to the high pulley. Look for the broad, flat hand rests in place of a round bar.
Grip the handle, secure your thighs under the pad, and lean back slightly. Pull toward your upper chest by bringing your elbows down.
Slowly straighten your arms overhead without rocking.

ex-back-one-arm-cable-seated-row.name: Single-Arm Seated Cable Row
steps: Use a low cable row station with footplates and attach a single handle.
Sit facing the cable with your feet braced and knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to your waist, keeping your elbow close.
Let the arm reach forward slowly, keeping your shoulders and hips square. Switch arms after the set.

ex-back-one-arm-dumbbell-row.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place your left hand and knee on a flat bench. Plant your right foot and hold the dumbbell in your right hand. Keep your back flat.
Row the weight toward your right hip without turning your shoulders.
Lower to a straight arm, then switch sides after the set.

ex-back-one-arm-high-row-machine.name: Single-Arm Machine High Row
steps: Use a seated high-row machine with two handles that move independently. Take one handle and steady yourself with your free hand.
Pull the handle down and back toward your ribs while keeping your shoulders square.
Let your arm extend slowly, then switch sides after the set.

ex-back-one-arm-lateral-wide-pulldown.name: Single-Arm Wide-Grip Machine Pulldown
steps: Find a machine with two widely spaced overhead handles that move independently.
Sit with your thighs under the pad, if fitted. Pull one handle down by driving your elbow toward the ribs on that side.
Let your arm straighten slowly without leaning sideways. Repeat on the other side.

ex-back-one-arm-low-row-machine.name: Single-Arm Machine Low Row
steps: Use a seated low-row machine with a chest pad and handles that move independently. Take one handle.
Pull the handle back and up toward your waist. Keep your elbow close and avoid twisting.
Let your arm reach forward slowly, then repeat on the other side.

ex-back-parallel-grip-lat-pulldown.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a parallel-grip handle to the high pulley and take it with your palms facing each other.
Sit with your thighs under the pad and lean back slightly. Pull to your upper chest, driving your elbows down close to your sides.
Let your arms straighten overhead without moving your torso.

ex-back-paused-barbell-row.name: Paused Barbell Row
steps: Grip a barbell overhand. Soften your knees and hinge at the hips with a flat back so your arms hang.
Pull the bar to your abdomen and hold for 1–2 seconds. Keep your torso still.
Lower until your arms are straight, then start the next rep from the same torso angle.

ex-back-pull-up.name: Pull-Up
steps: Take an overhand grip just wider than shoulder width and hang with your arms straight.
Drive your elbows down and pull until your chin clears the bar. Keep your legs still.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

ex-back-seated-cable-row.name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Use the low cable row station with a seat and footplates. Brace your feet, soften your knees, and take the handle in both hands.
Sit tall and pull the handle to your abdomen, driving your elbows back close to your sides.
Let your arms straighten slowly. Keep your torso still throughout the rep.

ex-back-seated-row-machine.name: Seated Machine Row
steps: Find the seated machine with a chest pad and handles at about rib height. Adjust it so you can reach the handles with your arms straight.
Keep your chest against the pad and pull the handles toward you, elbows traveling back.
Straighten your arms slowly without lifting your chest off the pad.

ex-back-smith-machine-row.name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
steps: Use the Smith machine with the bar on vertical rails. Set the safety stops just below the bar at the bottom of your row.
Grip the bar overhand, soften your knees, and hinge at the hips with a flat back. Rotate the bar to release it.
Pull to your abdomen, driving your elbows back. Lower slowly without standing up.
After the set, rotate the bar back and check that both hooks are engaged.

ex-back-t-bar-row-machine.name: Close-Grip T-Bar Row
steps: Find the floor-anchored T-bar with a close-grip handle and straddle the lever.
Soften your knees and hinge at your hips with a flat back. Grip with your palms facing each other.
Pull the handle toward your abdomen with elbows close to your sides. Lower slowly while holding your torso angle.

ex-back-underhand-barbell-row.name: Underhand Barbell Row
steps: Grip the bar about shoulder-width with palms facing forward. Soften your knees and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your lower abdomen, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Lower until your arms are straight while keeping your torso still.

ex-biceps-arm-curl-machine.name: Machine Biceps Curl
steps: Use the seated curl machine with an arm pad and moving handles. Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine’s pivot.
Rest your upper arms on the pad and hold the handles palms up.
Curl the handles toward you with your upper arms on the pad. Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

ex-biceps-barbbell-preacher-curl.name: Barbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the angled pad. Hold a straight barbell palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower the bar under control until your arms are nearly straight.

ex-biceps-barbell-wrist-curl.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with your forearms on your thighs and hands just past your knees. Hold a light barbell palms up.
Lower your hands slightly, then curl your wrists up while keeping your forearms still.
Lower slowly and keep a secure grip on the bar.

ex-biceps-cable-curl.name: Low Cable Biceps Curl
steps: Attach a short straight bar to a low pulley. Face the machine, grip palms up, and take a step back.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders. Keep your elbows by your sides and your torso still.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

ex-biceps-cable-hammer-curl.name: Rope Hammer Curl
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley. Take one end in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl the ends of the rope toward your shoulders without turning your wrists or bringing your elbows forward.
Straighten your arms slowly, keeping the same grip.

ex-biceps-dumbbell-bicep-curl.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward and elbows close to your body.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders. Keep your hips and shoulders still.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

ex-biceps-dumbbell-hammer-curl.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
steps: Hold a dumbbell at each side with your palms facing each other, as if holding two hammers.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders. Keep the same grip and your elbows by your sides.
Lower slowly without rocking your torso.

ex-biceps-dumbbell-preacher-curl.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench and rest one upper arm on the angled pad. Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm on the pad.
Lower until your arm is nearly straight, then switch arms after the set.

ex-biceps-dumbbell-wrist-curl.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with your forearms on your thighs and hands just past your knees. Hold light dumbbells palms up.
Lower your hands slightly, then curl your wrists up without lifting your forearms.
Lower your hands slowly while keeping a secure grip.

ex-biceps-ez-bar-curl.name: EZ-Bar Curl
steps: Hold the wavy EZ bar in front of your thighs with palms up, using matching bends on both sides.
Curl the bar toward your chest, keeping your elbows close and torso still.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

ex-biceps-ez-bar-preacher-curl.name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the angled pad. Grip matching bends of the EZ bar palms up.
Curl the bar toward you by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

ex-biceps-ez-bar-wrist-curl.name: EZ-Bar Wrist Curl
steps: Hold a light EZ bar palms up at matching bends. Rest your forearms on your thighs with your hands just past your knees.
Curl your wrists up without lifting your forearms.
Lower your hands slowly and keep hold of the bar.

ex-biceps-incline-dumbbell-curl.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Set the backrest to a 45–60° incline. Sit with your back supported and the dumbbells hanging at your sides, palms forward.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders. Keep your elbows from drifting forward.
Lower slowly with your back against the bench.

ex-biceps-preacher-curl-machine.name: Machine Preacher Curl
steps: Find the curl machine with an angled arm pad in front of the seat. Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Grip palms up and curl the handle toward you, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower until your arms are nearly straight, keeping the weight under control.

ex-biceps-reverse-barbell-curl.name: Reverse Barbell Curl
steps: Hold a straight bar overhand with palms facing your thighs. Stand tall with your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up. Keep your wrists straight as you lift.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

ex-biceps-reverse-barbell-wrist-curl.name: Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with your forearms on your thighs and your hands just past your knees. Hold a light bar palms down.
Raise your knuckles by moving only your wrists. Keep your forearms on your thighs.
Lower slowly to a comfortable starting position.

ex-biceps-reverse-dumbbell-wrist-curl.name: Reverse Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with your forearms on your thighs and your hands just past your knees. Hold light dumbbells palms down.
Lift your knuckles by moving only your wrists.
Lower your hands slowly with your forearms still supported.

ex-biceps-wrist-roller.name: Wrist Roller
steps: Take a wrist roller, a short handle with a cord and weight attached. Hold it in both hands in front of you, with the weight hanging clear of your feet.
Turn the handle one hand at a time to wind the cord and raise the weight.
Unwind the cord slowly to lower the weight under control.

ex-chest-archer-push-up.name: Archer Push-Up
steps: Place your hands well outside shoulder width. Get on your toes and keep your body in a straight line.
Shift your chest toward your right hand and bend your right elbow. Keep your left arm nearly straight.
Push through your right hand to return to the middle, then repeat to the left.

ex-chest-assisted-dip-machine.name: Assisted Dip
steps: Find the assisted dip machine with side handles and a moving knee pad. Select more counterweight to make the dip easier.
Take the handles, kneel on the pad, and lean slightly forward.
Bend your elbows and lower as far as your shoulders feel comfortable. Press down on the handles to straighten your arms.

ex-chest-barbell-bench-press.name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes below the bar. Plant your feet and draw your shoulder blades slightly together.
Grip just wider than shoulder width. Unrack the bar and hold it above your shoulders with straight arms.
Lower the bar toward your lower chest. Keep your wrists above your elbows and your hips on the bench.
Press the bar back up smoothly. Set the safety arms or use a spotter.

ex-chest-barbell-incline-bench-press.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline. Lie under the bar, plant your feet, and draw your shoulder blades together.
Grip just wider than shoulder width and unrack the bar. Lower it toward your upper chest with your wrists above your elbows.
Press up and slightly back until the bar is over your shoulders. Keep your hips on the bench.

ex-chest-chest-press-machine.name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Use a seated press with handles that move straight forward. Adjust the seat until the handles are level with the middle of your chest.
Keep your back against the pad and your feet on the floor. Press the handles forward.
Bring the handles slowly back toward your chest. Stop before your elbows travel far behind your body.

ex-chest-close-grip-push-up.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Start on your toes with your hands just inside shoulder width under your chest. Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor, driving your elbows back close to your sides.
Press the floor away to straighten your arms. Raise your chest and hips together.

ex-chest-decline-chest-press-machine.name: Machine Decline Chest Press
steps: Find a chest press with handles that travel forward and slightly down from your lower chest. If it has a decline bench, your head sits below your hips.
Set up with the handles at your lower chest. Secure your legs under the pads if the machine has them.
Press along the machine’s arc and return slowly while keeping your back against the pad.

ex-chest-decline-dumbbell-fly.name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Set a 15–30° decline and secure your legs under the rollers so your head is below your hips.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a gentle chest stretch. Bring the weights back along the same arc.

ex-chest-decline-push-up.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
steps: Place your toes on a stable low bench or box and your hands on the floor just wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest. Keep a straight line from your shoulders to your heels.
Push back to straight arms without letting your hips sag.

ex-chest-dips.name: Chest Dip
steps: Grip parallel bars and support yourself with straight arms. Let your feet hang and lean your chest slightly forward.
Bend your elbows and lower until you feel a gentle stretch in your chest. Use a shallower range if your shoulders feel uncomfortable.
Press down on the bars to straighten your arms without swinging.

ex-chest-dumbbell-bench-press.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted. Hold two dumbbells above your shoulders with your palms facing your feet.
Lower the weights to either side of your chest. Keep your elbows slightly tucked and your wrists above your elbows.
Press the dumbbells back over your shoulders without knocking them together.

ex-chest-dumbbell-fly.name: Flat Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor. Hold the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a gentle chest stretch. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed.
Bring the weights back over your chest as if hugging a large ball.

ex-chest-dumbbell-pullover.name: Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie lengthwise on a flat bench with your feet on the floor. Hold one dumbbell above your chest with both hands supporting the upper end.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head. Stop before your lower back arches farther.
Bring the dumbbell back above your chest along the same arc. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed.

ex-chest-dumbbell-squeeze-press.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and plant your feet. Hold two dumbbells together above your chest, palms facing each other.
Squeeze the dumbbells together and lower them to your chest, keeping your elbows close.
Press up while keeping pressure between the dumbbells.

ex-chest-hammer-bench-press.name: Hammer Strength Horizontal Bench Press
steps: Find a flat-bench press machine with two independent levers. If it is plate-loaded, put the same weight on both sides.
Lie on the bench with your feet braced and take the handles at chest level.
Press the levers up, then bend your elbows slowly to return the handles to your chest.

ex-chest-incline-bench-press-machine.name: Machine Incline Chest Press
steps: Find the incline press machine with two upward-moving levers. If the backrest adjusts, start at 30–45°.
Lie back with your feet planted and take the handles at upper-chest level.
Press the levers up. Bend your elbows slowly to bring the handles back toward your chest.

ex-chest-incline-cable-fly.name: Incline Cable Fly
steps: Place a bench between two cable towers, set the backrest to 30–45°, and lower both pulleys.
Lie back and take a handle in each hand. Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in an arc over your upper chest. Open your arms to a gentle stretch without changing the bend in your elbows.

ex-chest-incline-dumbbell-bench-press.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline. Lie back with feet planted and hold the dumbbells above your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells to either side of your upper chest. Keep your wrists above your elbows.
Press up without touching the dumbbells together or lifting your hips from the bench.

ex-chest-incline-dumbbell-fly.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline. Hold the dumbbells above your upper chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a gentle chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells together along the same arc. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed.

ex-chest-incline-push-up.name: Incline Push-Up
steps: Place your hands just wider than your shoulders on a stable bench or box. Step back and balance on your toes.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the edge, keeping your body straight.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms.

ex-chest-knee-push-up.name: Knee Push-Up
steps: Start on hands and knees with your hands just wider than your shoulders. Shift your hips forward so your shoulders, hips, and knees form a straight line.
Bend your elbows back and slightly out as you lower your chest toward the floor.
Push through your hands, raising your chest and hips together.

ex-chest-low-pulley-cable-fly.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
steps: Stand between two cable towers and set both pulleys low, around shin height.
Take the handles and step forward. Start with your hands low at your sides and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your hands up and together at upper-chest height. Lower along the same arc without bending your elbows farther.

ex-chest-push-up.name: Push-Up
steps: Place your hands just wider than your shoulders and get on your toes. Brace your abs to keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows slightly back and lower your chest toward the floor. Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms.

ex-chest-seated-dips-machine.name: Seated Machine Dip
steps: Find the seated machine with side handles that push down. Secure the thigh pad if fitted.
Grip the handles and press down until your arms are straight. Keep your hips on the seat.
Bend your elbows slowly to let the handles rise.

ex-chest-smith-machine-incline-bench-pre.name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
steps: Place a bench under the Smith machine’s guided bar. Set the backrest to a 30–45° incline.
Use the empty bar to check that it lowers to your upper chest. Set the safety stops just below that point.
Plant your feet. Rotate the bar to unhook it and lower it toward your chest.
Press the bar back up. After the set, rotate it back and check that the hooks are engaged.

ex-chest-standing-cable-fly.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
steps: Set both cable pulleys above shoulder height. Take a handle in each hand and step forward.
Lean slightly forward with a slight bend in your elbows. Sweep your hands down and together in front of your lower chest.
Let your arms open back and up to a gentle stretch. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed.

ex-legs-back-squat.name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack just below shoulder height and the safety arms just below the bottom of your squat. Try it with an empty bar first.
Step under the bar and rest it on the muscles of your upper back below your neck. Unrack it and step back.
Squat with your heels planted and your knees tracking in the direction of your toes.
Stand up with your shoulders and hips rising together. Return the bar to the rack after the set.

ex-legs-barbell-bulgarian-split-squat.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand with a flat bench behind you, no higher than your knee. Rehearse the movement without weight, then rest the bar on your upper back below your neck.
Rest the top of your rear foot on the bench. Set your front foot far enough ahead that your heel stays down as you lower.
Bend both knees and lower the rear knee. Keep most of your weight on the front foot.
Drive through the front foot to stand. Switch legs after the set.

ex-legs-barbell-hip-thrust.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with a stable flat bench behind you. Rest your upper back against the edge just below your shoulder blades.
Rest a padded barbell across your hip crease and steady it with both hands. Set your feet so your shins are nearly vertical at the top.
Lift your hips until they line up with your shoulders and knees. Squeeze your glutes without arching your lower back.
Lower your hips slowly while holding the bar in place.

ex-legs-barbell-lunge.name: Barbell Forward Lunge
steps: Unrack the bar with it resting on the muscles of your upper back below your neck. Start with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward and bend both knees until your rear knee is just above the floor. Keep your front heel down.
Push through your whole front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.

ex-legs-barbell-split-squat.name: Barbell Split Squat
steps: Unrack the bar onto your upper back below your neck. Step one foot forward and balance on the toes of your rear foot. Keep some width between your feet, as if standing on two tracks.
Bend both knees and lower the rear knee while keeping your front heel down.
Push through your front foot to rise without moving either foot. Switch sides after the set.

ex-legs-barbell-sumo-squat.name: Barbell Sumo Squat
steps: Unrack the bar onto your upper back below your neck. Stand wider than shoulder width with your toes turned slightly out.
Bend your knees and sit down between your feet. Keep your whole foot on the floor and let your knees follow your toes.
Drive through both feet to stand. Return the bar to the rack after the set.

ex-legs-cable-hip-abduction.name: Cable Hip Abduction
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley. Stand sideways, strap the ankle farthest from the machine, and hold the frame for balance.
Move that leg out to the side with toes pointing forward. Stay upright.
Return your foot slowly beneath your hip. Turn around to switch sides.

ex-legs-conventional-deadlift.name: Conventional Deadlift
steps: Stand about hip-width with the bar on the floor over the middle of your feet.
Hinge at the hips, bend your knees, and grip the bar just outside your legs. Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall with the bar close to your shins and thighs. Finish upright.
Push your hips back, then bend your knees to guide the bar back to the floor.

ex-legs-dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand in front of a stable bench no higher than your knee. Rest the top of your rear foot on it and hold the dumbbells at your sides.
Bend both knees and lower your rear knee. Keep your weight over your front foot with your heel down.
Drive through the front foot to stand. Switch sides after the set.

ex-legs-dumbbell-goblet-squat.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest with both hands cupping the upper end. Stand about shoulder-width apart.
Squat with the dumbbell close to your chest and your heels planted. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through both feet to stand.

ex-legs-dumbbell-lateral-lunge.name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Take a wide step to one side and plant your whole foot.
Sit your hips back over that foot and bend that knee. Keep the other leg nearly straight and both heels down.
Push off the stepping leg to stand, then repeat on the other side.

ex-legs-dumbbell-lunge.name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell at each side. Take a step forward.
Bend both knees and lower the rear knee close to the floor. Keep your whole front foot planted.
Push through the front foot to return to standing and switch legs.

ex-legs-dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs. Stand hip-width apart with a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and let the weights travel close to your legs. Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch while your back is still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall without leaning back.

ex-legs-dumbbell-split-squat.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides. Put one foot in front and the other on its toes behind you, with some width between your feet.
Bend both knees and lower your rear knee, keeping your whole front foot down.
Drive through your front foot to rise without moving either foot. Switch sides after the set.

ex-legs-dumbbell-stiff-leg-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand with the dumbbells in front of your thighs. Keep your knees nearly straight with a slight bend.
Hinge at your hips and lower the dumbbells along your legs, keeping the knee angle almost fixed. Stop before your back rounds.
Drive your hips forward smoothly to stand tall.

ex-legs-dumbbell-sumo-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Set a dumbbell on the floor between your feet. Take a wide stance with toes turned slightly out.
Bend your knees, grasp the upper end of the dumbbell with both hands, and stand up with a flat back. Let your knees follow your toes.
Bend your knees again and set the dumbbell down under control.

ex-legs-dumbbell-sumo-squat.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
steps: Take a wide stance with your toes slightly out. Hold a dumbbell by the upper end with both hands and let it hang between your legs.
Squat between your feet, keeping your knees in line with your toes and your heels down.
Keep both feet flat as you stand. Keep the dumbbell off the floor between reps.

ex-legs-front-squat.name: Barbell Front Squat
steps: Unrack the bar onto the front of your shoulders. Point your elbows forward and up, using your fingers to steady the bar.
Squat between your feet with your elbows high and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand while keeping your elbows up. Rack the bar after the set.

ex-legs-glute-bridge.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet about hip-width apart. Set your heels close to your glutes.
Press through your feet to lift your hips until your shoulders, hips, and knees are roughly in line. Keep your lower back neutral.
Squeeze your glutes briefly, then lower your hips slowly.

ex-legs-glute-kickback-machine.name: Machine Glute Kickback
steps: Find a machine with handles and a moving pad or pedal you can push back with one leg. Take the handles and place your foot or shin on the support as shown on the machine.
Drive your thigh back against the support. Keep your hips square and avoid arching your lower back.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

ex-legs-hack-squat-machine.name: Machine Hack Squat
steps: Find a machine with angled rails, a back pad, and shoulder pads. Step onto the platform with your back against the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Straighten your legs slightly to release the catches. Squat while keeping your heels on the platform.
Press through both feet to stand smoothly. Re-engage the catches after the set.

ex-legs-hip-abduction-machine.name: Machine Hip Abduction
steps: Sit at the machine with the pads on the outside of your thighs, just above your knees. Put your feet on the supports and your back against the pad.
Press both pads outward while keeping your hips on the seat.
Slowly bring your legs back together, keeping the weight under control.

ex-legs-hip-thrust-machine.name: Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Find the machine with an upper-back support, footplate, and padded belt or roller.
Set your upper back against the support and plant your feet. Secure the belt or lower the pad across your hip crease.
Lift your hips until they line up with your shoulders and knees. Squeeze your glutes, lower slowly, and secure the lever after the set.

ex-legs-horizontal-leg-press.name: Horizontal Leg Press
steps: Use the leg press with a broad footplate and a seat or platform that moves almost horizontally. Keep your hips and lower back against the pad.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart and press until your legs are nearly straight. Let your knees follow your toes.
Bend your knees slowly. Stop before your hips or lower back lift off the pad.

ex-legs-inner-thigh-machine.name: Machine Hip Adduction
steps: Sit at the machine with the pads against your inner thighs, just above the knees. Choose a starting width that feels comfortable.
Rest your back against the pad and your feet on the supports. Press your thighs together against the pads.
Let your legs open slowly without dropping the weight.

ex-legs-kettlebell-deadlift.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
steps: Place a kettlebell on the floor between feet about hip-width apart. Hinge at the hips, bend your knees, and take the handle with both hands.
Drive through your feet to stand tall with a flat back. Keep your arms straight and the kettlebell close to your legs.
Hinge back and bend your knees to return the kettlebell to the floor.

ex-legs-leg-curl.name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with your knees lined up with the lever pivot. Set the roller just above your heels.
Bend your knees to pull your heels toward your glutes. Keep your hips on the pad.
Slowly straighten your legs without dropping the weight.

ex-legs-leg-extension.name: Leg Extension
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and the roller just above your ankles. Line up your knees with the machine’s pivot.
Straighten your legs to lift the roller, keeping your hips on the seat.
Bend your knees slowly to lower the roller.

ex-legs-leg-press.name: Incline Leg Press
steps: Find a leg press with a backrest and a broad platform that slides on angled rails. Keep your hips and lower back against the pad.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart. Press the platform slightly away and release the safety catches.
Bend your knees to lower the platform, stopping before your hips lift. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Keep both feet flat as you press the platform away. Avoid snapping your knees straight. Re-engage the catches after the set.

ex-legs-lunge.name: Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Step forward, keeping some width between your feet.
Bend both knees until your rear knee is just above the floor. Keep your whole front foot down.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then repeat with the other leg.

ex-legs-pistol-squat.name: Pistol Squat
steps: Shift your weight onto one leg. Reach the other leg and both arms forward. Hold a fixed support for balance if needed.
Squat on the standing leg as far as you can keep your heel down. Let the knee track over your toes and keep the other leg off the floor.
Stand up on the same leg, then repeat on the other side.

ex-legs-reverse-v-squat.name: Reverse V-Squat
steps: Find the V-squat machine with shoulder pads on a lever that moves in an arc. Face the back pad and position your shoulders under the pads.
Put both feet flat on the platform, hold the handles, and straighten your legs to release the catch.
Sit your hips back into a squat with a flat back. Drive through both feet to stand.
Re-engage the catch after the set.

ex-legs-romanian-deadlift.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold the bar at your thighs with straight arms. Stand about hip-width apart with your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower the bar close to your legs. Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings and your back is still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall without leaning back.

ex-legs-seated-calf-raise.name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Find the seated machine with a foot ledge and pads that rest on your thighs above the knees. Put the balls of your feet on the ledge and let your heels hang.
Raise your heels slightly to release the catch. Rise onto the balls of your feet and pause.
Lower your heels slowly to a comfortable calf stretch. Re-engage the catch after the set.

ex-legs-seated-leg-curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit at the machine with your knees lined up with the lever pivot. Secure your thighs with the upper pad.
Set the roller just above your heels. Bend your knees to bring your heels under the seat without lifting your hips.
Slowly straighten your legs while keeping the weight under control.

ex-legs-seated-single-leg-leg-curl.name: Single-Leg Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit at the leg curl machine and secure your thighs under the upper pad. Place one leg on the roller just above the heel. Keep the other leg clear of the lever.
Bend the working knee to bring your heel under the seat. Keep your hips square.
Straighten the leg slowly, then switch sides after the set.

ex-legs-single-leg-glute-bridge.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back. Bend one knee and plant that foot. Extend the other leg in front of you and keep it off the floor.
Drive through the planted foot to lift your hips. Keep your hips level and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after the set.

ex-legs-single-leg-leg-curl.name: Single-Leg Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down at the leg curl machine. Line up the working knee with the pivot and place the roller just above that heel. Keep the other leg clear.
Bend the working knee to pull your heel toward your glutes. Keep your hips against the bench.
Slowly straighten your leg and switch sides after the set.

ex-legs-single-leg-leg-extension.name: Single-Leg Extension
steps: Sit at the leg extension machine. Place the roller just above one ankle and align that knee with the pivot. Keep the other leg clear of the lever.
Straighten the working leg to raise the roller. Keep your hips on the seat.
Lower the roller slowly and switch sides after the set.

ex-legs-single-leg-leg-press.name: Single-Leg Incline Leg Press
steps: Sit at the leg press with the platform on angled rails. Keep your hips and lower back against the pad.
Put one foot on the platform in line with that hip. Keep your other foot clear, press the platform slightly away, and release the catches.
Bend the working knee while keeping your hips level, then press smoothly. Re-engage the catches before switching legs.

ex-legs-smith-machine-deadlift.name: Smith Machine Deadlift
steps: Use the Smith machine with a bar that slides on rails and rotates to unhook. Set the lower stops to a height you can reach with a flat back.
Stand close to the bar, bend your knees, and grip it just outside them. Unhook it and stand, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the bar. Rotate it to engage the hooks after the set.

ex-legs-smith-machine-split-squat.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine safety stops and rest the guided bar on your upper back below your neck.
Put one foot forward and the other behind you on its toes. Unhook the bar and bend both knees, keeping your front heel down.
Drive through the front foot to rise. Rehook the bar before switching legs.

ex-legs-smith-machine-squat.name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine safety stops just below the bottom of your squat. Rest the guided bar on your upper back below your neck.
Rotate the bar to unhook it. Squat with both feet flat and knees following your toes.
Drive through both feet to stand. Rotate the bar back onto the hooks after the set.

ex-legs-standing-calf-raise.name: Standing Calf Raise
steps: Find the machine with two shoulder pads and a small platform. Put the balls of your feet on the edge with heels hanging and shoulders under the pads.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, keeping your knees nearly straight.
Lower your heels slowly until you feel a comfortable stretch in your calves.

ex-legs-step-up.name: Step-Up
steps: Start with a sturdy box lower than your knee. Place one whole foot on top.
Shift your weight onto that leg and stand on the box without pushing off the floor with the other foot.
Slowly lower your free foot back to the floor, then switch sides.

ex-legs-stiff-leg-deadlift.name: Barbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Hold the bar at your thighs with your arms straight and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips and lower the bar along your legs, keeping the knee angle almost fixed. Stop before your back rounds.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall. Lower only as far as you can control.

ex-legs-trap-bar-deadlift.name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
steps: Stand inside the trap bar, the closed frame with handles on both sides. Bend your knees and take the handles.
Press through your feet and stand tall with a flat back and straight arms. Finish upright.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the bar to the floor.

ex-legs-v-squat.name: Machine V-Squat
steps: Find the machine with a footplate and shoulder pads on a lever that moves in an arc. Stand with your back against the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Put both feet flat on the platform and release the catch. Squat with your back on the pad and heels on the platform.
Press through both feet to stand. Re-engage the catch after the set.

ex-legs-zercher-squat.name: Zercher Squat
steps: Set the bar in a rack at about elbow height. Hook the crooks of your elbows under the bar and unrack it, holding it close to your abdomen.
Squat with your heels down and torso upright.
Drive through your feet to stand. Return the bar to the rack after the set.

ex-shoulders-arnold-dumbbell-press.name: Arnold Press
steps: Sit with your feet on the floor. If using an adjustable bench, set the backrest almost upright at 75–85°.
Bring the dumbbells in front of your shoulders with your palms facing you and elbows in front of your chest.
Press overhead while moving your elbows out and turning your palms forward.
Lower to your shoulders as you turn your palms back toward you.

ex-shoulders-barbell-front-raise.name: Barbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with a light bar in front of your thighs. Grip at shoulder width with palms facing your legs.
Soften your elbows and lift the bar in front of you to about shoulder height. Keep your torso upright.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

ex-shoulders-barbell-shrug.name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Hold the bar in front of your thighs, hands just wider than your hips and palms facing your legs.
With straight arms, lift your shoulders toward your ears. Keep your head neutral and avoid rolling your shoulders.
Lower your shoulders slowly, keeping your arms straight.

ex-shoulders-barbell-upright-row.name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Hold the bar at your thighs with hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing you.
Pull the bar close to your body, leading with elbows out to the sides. Stop around shoulder height at the elbows, even if the bar is below your chin.
Lower slowly without rocking your torso.

ex-shoulders-behind-neck-press.name: Behind-the-Neck Barbell Press
steps: Set a light bar in a rack at about shoulder height. Take a grip wider than your shoulders and press overhead.
Slowly lower the bar behind your head to a comfortable depth. Look straight ahead and keep your neck neutral.
Press the bar back up. If lowering behind your head feels restricted, use a front overhead press instead.

ex-shoulders-bentover-dumbbell-lateral-r.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Hold light dumbbells, bend your knees slightly, and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders with palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides until your elbows are roughly in line with your shoulders. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed.
Lower the weights slowly without standing up between reps.

ex-shoulders-cable-external-roation.name: Cable Shoulder External Rotation
steps: Set a single cable handle at elbow height and choose a light weight.
Stand sideways and take the handle with the hand farthest from the pulley. Bend your elbow to 90° and hold it by your side, hand in front of your abdomen.
Rotate your hand out to the side. Keep your elbow against your side and your torso still.
Return slowly, then switch arms after the set.

ex-shoulders-cable-front-raise.name: Cable Front Raise
steps: Attach a short straight bar to a low pulley. Face away from the machine with the cable running between your legs.
Hold the bar in front of your thighs, palms facing you and elbows slightly bent.
Lift the bar in front of you to shoulder height. Keep your torso still and your elbows at the same angle.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

ex-shoulders-cable-internal-rotation.name: Cable Shoulder Internal Rotation
steps: Set a single cable handle at elbow height and choose a light weight.
Stand sideways and take the handle with the hand closest to the pulley. Bend your elbow to 90° and hold it against your side, forearm pointing toward the machine.
Rotate your hand in toward your abdomen. Keep your elbow by your side and your torso still.
Return slowly, then switch arms after the set.

ex-shoulders-cable-lateral-raise.name: Dual-Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Set both pulleys low and attach single handles. Stand between the towers, taking the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left.
Start with your hands in front of your thighs and elbows slightly bent. Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower the handles slowly. Stay upright and keep your shoulders down.

ex-shoulders-cable-reverse-fly.name: Cable Reverse Fly
steps: Set the pulleys to about shoulder height. Take the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left.
Stand between the towers with your hands in front of your chest and the cables crossed. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms until they are roughly in line with your shoulders. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed.
Bring your hands back in front of your chest slowly without rocking.

ex-shoulders-cable-shrug.name: Cable Shrug
steps: Attach single handles to two low pulleys. Stand between them with a handle in each hand and your arms straight at your sides.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears without bending your elbows. Keep your head neutral.
Lower your shoulders smoothly as the cables pull your arms down, keeping the weight under control.

ex-shoulders-dumbbell-front-raise.name: Alternating Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing you. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height without leaning back.
Lower slowly and repeat with the other arm.

ex-shoulders-dumbbell-lateral-raise.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your thighs and elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out and slightly forward until your elbows reach about shoulder height. Keep your shoulders down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging.

ex-shoulders-dumbbell-shoulder-press.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Hold the dumbbells beside your head, palms forward and wrists over your elbows.
Press the dumbbells overhead without using your legs or arching your lower back.
Lower slowly to a comfortable depth at your shoulders.

ex-shoulders-dumbbell-shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your thighs and arms straight.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears. Keep your elbows straight and avoid rolling your shoulders.
Lower slowly with your head neutral.

ex-shoulders-dumbbell-upright-row.name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull the dumbbells up close to your body, leading with elbows up and out. Stop when your elbows are about shoulder height.
Lower slowly to your thighs, keeping your torso upright.

ex-shoulders-dumbbell-y-raise.name: Incline Dumbbell Y Raise
steps: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline and lie face down with your feet on the floor. Use light dumbbells.
Let your arms hang under your shoulders, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms forward and out to make a Y. Point your thumbs up and keep your chest against the bench.
Lower your arms slowly until they hang below your shoulders.

ex-shoulders-ez-bar-front-raise.name: EZ-Bar Front Raise
steps: Hold matching bends of an EZ bar in front of your thighs, palms facing your legs.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the bar in front of you to shoulder height. Stay upright.
Lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

ex-shoulders-ez-bar-upright-row.name: EZ-Bar Upright Row
steps: Grip matching bends of an EZ bar with your palms facing your legs. Start with the bar in front of your thighs.
Pull the bar up close to your body, elbows out to the sides. Stop when your elbows are around shoulder height.
Lower slowly without rocking.

ex-shoulders-face-pull.name: Rope Face Pull
steps: Attach a rope to a pulley around eye level.
Hold the ends of the rope, extend your arms, and step back until the cable is taut.
Pull the ends toward your temples, elbows out to the sides. Keep your torso upright.
Slowly let your arms extend toward the pulley.

ex-shoulders-landmine-press.name: Two-Hand Landmine Press
steps: Find the landmine attachment, a pivoting sleeve near the floor. Insert one end of the barbell into the sleeve.
Face the anchored end. Hold the free end with both hands in front of your chest.
Press the bar forward and up at an angle without arching your lower back.
Slowly return the bar to your chest.

ex-shoulders-lateral-raise-machine.name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Find the seated machine with pads at your sides that swing outward and up.
Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivots. Plant your feet and place your elbows or forearms against the pads.
Push the pads out until your elbows reach about shoulder height.
Lower the pads slowly with your torso upright.

ex-shoulders-one-arm-cable-lateral-raise.name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley. Stand sideways and take the handle with your far hand.
Start with your hand in front of your thighs and your elbow slightly bent. Raise your arm out to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without leaning to the side. Switch arms after the set.

ex-shoulders-one-arm-landmine-press.name: Single-Arm Landmine Press
steps: Find the landmine attachment, a pivoting sleeve near the floor, and insert one end of the barbell.
Face the anchored end and hold the free end at shoulder height with one hand.
Press the bar forward and up at an angle. Keep your chest and hips square.
Return the bar to your shoulder slowly. Switch arms after the set.

ex-shoulders-overhead-press.name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Set the bar in a rack just below your shoulders. Grip just wider than shoulder width and unrack it to your collarbones. Stand hip-width apart.
Draw your head back slightly to clear the bar. Press straight up without using your legs.
Once the bar clears your head, bring your head back under it. Keep your lower back neutral.
Lower the bar slowly to your collarbones and rack it after the set.

ex-shoulders-plate-shoulder-press.name: Plate Overhead Press
steps: Stand tall and hold a weight plate by its sides in front of your chest, elbows bent.
Press the plate overhead without leaning back.
Bend your elbows slowly to return the plate to your chest.

ex-shoulders-push-press.name: Barbell Push Press
steps: Stand hip-width apart with the bar at your collarbones. Grip just wider than shoulder width with elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, keeping your torso upright.
Immediately drive through your legs and finish the press overhead. Keep your knees straight as you finish.
Guide the bar back to your shoulders, bending your knees slightly to cushion it.

ex-shoulders-reverse-pec-deck-fly-machin.name: Reverse Pec Deck
steps: Find the pec deck with a seat and two handles that move in an arc.
Sit facing the pad. Set the handles close together in front of you and adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Take the handles with elbows slightly bent. Open your arms to shoulder level while keeping your chest on the pad.
Bring the handles back slowly, keeping the bend in your elbows fixed.

ex-shoulders-seated-barbell-shoulder-pre.name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Set a bench in a power rack with the backrest almost upright at 75–85°. Set the bar in front of you just below shoulder height.
Sit with your feet planted. Grip just wider than shoulder width and unrack the bar to your collarbones.
Press overhead, drawing your head back slightly to clear the bar. Keep your lower back neutral.
Lower slowly to your collarbones and rack the bar after the set.

ex-shoulders-seated-dumbbell-rear-latera.name: Seated Dumbbell Reverse Fly
steps: Sit at the edge of a flat bench with your feet planted. Lean your chest toward your thighs with a flat back.
Let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to about shoulder height. Hold your torso angle and the bend in your elbows.
Lower slowly until the weights hang below your shoulders.

ex-shoulders-seated-dumbbell-shoulder-pr.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Set the backrest almost upright at 75–85°. Sit with your back supported and your feet on the floor.
Hold the dumbbells beside your head, palms forward and wrists above your elbows.
Press above your shoulders without lifting your back off the bench.
Lower the dumbbells slowly toward your shoulders to a comfortable depth.

ex-shoulders-shoulder-press-machine.name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Find the seated press with a back pad and handles that travel upward.
Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height. Plant your feet, rest your back on the pad, and grip palms forward.
Press the handles up with wrists above elbows.
Lower slowly to your shoulders, keeping your back against the pad.

ex-shoulders-smith-machine-overhead-pres.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set a bench under the Smith machine’s guided bar. Adjust the backrest to 75–85°.
Check with the empty bar that it lowers in front of your face to about collarbone height. Set the safety stops just below that point.
Sit with your feet planted. Rotate the bar to unhook it and press overhead without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly to your collarbones. After the set, rotate the bar back and check that the hooks are engaged.

ex-shoulders-smith-machine-shrug.name: Smith Machine Shrug
steps: Set the Smith machine’s guided bar just below mid-thigh height and stand close to it.
Grip with palms facing your legs. Stand tall and rotate the bar to unhook it.
Shrug your shoulders toward your ears with straight arms, then lower slowly. Keep your torso upright.
Rotate the bar back onto its hooks after the set.

ex-triceps-bench-dips.name: Bench Dip
steps: Put your hands on the edge of a stable bench beside your hips. Slide your hips off the edge with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Bend your elbows back and lower your hips close to the bench. Stop at a depth that feels comfortable for your shoulders.
Press through your hands to straighten your arms, keeping your hips close to the bench.

ex-triceps-cable-lying-tricep-extension.name: Lying Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Put a flat bench with its head end toward the cable machine. Attach a short straight bar to the low pulley.
Lie on your back and hold the bar over your shoulders. Bend your elbows to bring your hands behind your head.
Straighten your arms by moving only your forearms. Keep your upper arms still.

ex-triceps-cable-overhead-tricep-extensi.name: High-Pulley Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to the high pulley. Hold both ends and turn away from the machine.
Step forward and lean slightly. Point your elbows forward beside your head and start with your hands behind your head.
Straighten your arms forward. Bring your hands back slowly while keeping your elbows in place.

ex-triceps-cable-push-down.name: Straight-Bar Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a short straight bar to the high pulley. Face the machine and grip palms down.
Bend your elbows and hold them close to your sides. Push the bar down toward your thighs until your arms are straight.
Let the bar rise slowly while keeping your elbows by your sides.

ex-triceps-cable-tricep-extension.name: Straight-Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a short straight bar to a high pulley. Grip it and face away from the machine with one foot forward.
Lean forward slightly. Keep your elbows beside your head and start with the bar behind it.
Straighten your arms forward, then bring the bar behind your head slowly. Keep your elbows in place.

ex-triceps-close-grip-bench-press.name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted. Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart and unrack it.
Lower the bar toward your lower chest. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your wrists above your elbows.
Press the bar back up. Set the safety arms or use a spotter.

ex-triceps-dumbbell-kickback.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand. Hinge at your hips with a flat back and brace your free hand on a bench.
Bring your working elbow up beside your ribs and bend it so the dumbbell hangs below it.
Straighten your arm behind you while keeping your elbow still. Lower slowly and switch arms after the set.

ex-triceps-dumbbell-tricep-extension.name: Standing Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall. Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the upper end.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head. Keep your elbows pointing up and your lower back neutral.
Straighten your arms overhead without letting your elbows flare.

ex-triceps-seated-dumbbell-tricep-extens.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet planted. Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the upper end.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head. Keep your elbows pointing up and your back neutral.
Straighten your elbows to return the dumbbell overhead.

ex-triceps-skull-crusher.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted. Hold a light EZ bar above your shoulders.
Bend only your elbows, guiding the bar toward your forehead. Stop just before it touches.
Straighten your arms to raise the bar, keeping your upper arms still.

ex-triceps-tricep-extension-machine.name: Machine Triceps Extension
steps: Find the machine with an angled arm pad and handles you press away from you. Set the seat so your elbows line up with the lever pivot.
Rest your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles. Extend your elbows without lifting your arms off the pad.
Bend your elbows slowly to return the handles.

exercise-02fb73ca-fb79-4956-8bfa-7d1533d.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Put a flat bench under the Smith machine’s guided bar. Check with the empty bar that it lowers to your lower chest. Set the safety stops.
Lie down with feet planted. Draw your shoulder blades together and grip just wider than shoulder width. Rotate the bar to unhook it.
Lower the bar to your chest and press it back up. After the set, rotate the bar back and check that the hooks are engaged.

exercise-182a5d45-97aa-40a2-97db-2cd98c6.name: Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Hold both ends, face away from the machine, and step forward.
Lean forward slightly with elbows beside your head and hands behind it. Straighten your arms forward and separate the rope ends slightly.
Bring your hands slowly behind your head again. Keep your elbows in place.

exercise-38cbd71e-be01-4281-94e4-824669e.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Face the machine and hold the rope ends with your elbows close to your sides.
Straighten your arms down toward your thighs. Separate the ends of the rope slightly at the bottom.
Bend your elbows slowly to let the rope rise, keeping your upper arms against your sides.

exercise-72de012a-9095-4fd7-b0ee-88d5468.name: Pec Deck Fly
steps: Sit at the pec deck, the machine with side levers that come together in front of you. Adjust the seat so your arms are at chest height.
Place your forearms on the pads, or take the handles with elbows slightly bent. Keep your back against the pad.
Bring the levers together, then open slowly to a gentle chest stretch. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed.

exercise-804ffcd1-1744-46b8-b572-80026ec.name: Triceps Dip
steps: Grip parallel bars and support yourself on straight arms with your torso almost upright.
Bend your elbows back alongside your body to lower. Stop before your shoulders feel uncomfortable.
Press down on the bars to straighten your arms without using your legs.

exercise-9615d7db-0c0c-42b2-8d36-800a909.name: Machine T-Bar Row
steps: Use the T-bar machine with an angled footplate and a long lever with handles in front. Stand on the platform and use the chest pad if fitted.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back. Without a pad, hold a steady forward lean with a flat back.
Lower the lever slowly until your arms are straight.

exercise-9ad172c9-14be-4445-a5c2-ec48ac6.name: Incline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
steps: Set a bench to a 30–45° incline. Lie back and hold two dumbbells over your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells to either side of your forehead, keeping your upper arms still.
Straighten your elbows to return the weights above your shoulders.

exercise-bb4a1a8e-da47-4af1-a32d-664df2a.name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Hold a weight plate by its sides in front of your thighs. Stand tall with your elbows slightly bent.
Raise the plate in front of you to about shoulder height without leaning back.
Lower the plate slowly to your thighs.

exercise-e3662541-c9e6-4bcc-9e0d-2766454.name: Close-Grip Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Put a flat bench under the Smith machine’s guided bar. Set the safety stops and take a shoulder-width grip.
Rotate the bar to unhook it. Lower to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar back up. After the set, rotate the bar back and check that the hooks are engaged.
